scheme.name: corrected
scheme.description: Data point has been adjusted from its original value.

scheme.name: estimated
scheme.description: Data point is an estimate in some way, either through infilling techniques or incomplete derivation.

scheme.name: removed
scheme.description: Data point was removed by quality control.

scheme.name: suspicious
scheme.description: Data point is potentially erroneous or requiring further investigation.

scheme.name: unchecked
scheme.description: Data point has not been verified by QC.

scheme.name: unsuccessful_correction
scheme.description: A correction was attempted but was unsuccessful due to missing input data.
